span.label: existence
span.quote: The key finding of this paper is that the representations of content and style in the Convolutional Neural Network are separable.

span.label: separation of image content and style in CNN representations
span.quote: Here we present an artificial neural system that achieves a separation of image content from style, thus allowing to recast the content of one image in the style of any other image.

span.label: system-or-tool-building
span.quote: Here we introduce an artificial system based on a Deep Neural Network that creates artistic images of high perceptual quality.

span.quote: Of course, image content and style cannot be completely disentangled.

span.label: No image satisfies both the content and the style constraint perfectly; a trade-off has to be tuned per image pair.
span.quote: When synthesising an image that combines the content of one image with the style of another, there usually does not exist an image that perfectly matches both constraints at the same time.

span.label: What the paper calls style is a texture statistic that discards the composition of the image, in a feature space built for something else.
span.quote: we use a feature space originally designed to capture texture information.8 This feature space is built on top of the filter responses in each layer of the network. It consists of the correlations between the different filter responses over the spatial extent of the feature maps (see Methods for details). By including the feature correlations of multiple layers, we obtain a stationary, multi-scale representation of the input image, which captures its texture information but not the global arrangement
